raw.retained_raw_text: {"edits":[{"claim_id":"claim_561d7dd60df84aeb4419a8fa_1","replacement_text":"The light-dependent reactions convert light energy into chemical energy stored in energy carriers, and these carriers transport that energy to the Calvin cycle [ev_008] [ev_005] [ev_007]."},{"claim_id":"claim_4454c191da4f22851a66800a_1","replacement_text":"The energy carriers are described as \"full\" when they carry energy from the light-dependent reactions to the Calvin cycle, and as \"empty\" after the energy is released, when they return to the light-dependent reactions to obtain more energy [ev_001]."}],"append_answer_text":""}
